events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after batch 3: 120 records migrated; validation reports incorrect +1 phone prefixes on 31 overseas customer records. Sales is already using the new CRM; 14 users opened customer records in the last 24 hours, though affected-record usage is unknown. Please have the CRM owner identify the affected records, verify country codes against authoritative data, and correct the migration mapping before resuming. The 31 migrated phone numbers also need verified corrections; I can apply them once the customer IDs and correct numbers are supplied and authorized.
